heading: LNLS.3.3 requires logical-lifecycle schemas
text:
### LNLS.3.3 requires logical-lifecycle schemas [LNOG.6.1]

The `linear_scan: false` constraint LNLS.3.3 requires that every multi-pattern
rule have an equality anchor between the **identity slots of
`logical`-lifecycle schemas** on both join sides.  This guarantees
J_max = 1 (at most one live fact per identity-slot value) and makes the
join O(1).

The proof of J_max = 1 depends on `logical` retract-and-replace
semantics: the `logical` lifecycle ensures that asserting a second fact
with the same identity-slot value retracts the first.  This guarantee
does not hold for `explicit`, `ttl`, `ambient`, or `activation`
lifecycle schemas — multiple facts with the same key can coexist.
